{{Quote|Out! Out! Get out of my house!|Darrb, to Kazuda Xiono and Norath Kev|translated=1|audio=OutOfMyHouse-Breakout.flac|<ref name="Breakout">{{Resistance|Breakout}}</ref>}}
'''Darrb''' was a [[Gabdorin]] [[Gender|male]] [[Merchant|vendor]] who resided on the [[planet]] [[Varkana]] in [[34 ABY]]. He had a [[Darrb's house|home]] on Varkana and sold [[fruit]]s and [[vegetable]]s in the [[Vargo Spaceport]]. His [[Darrb's stand|stand]] in the [[spaceport]] was disturbed by passing [[Resistance]] member [[Kazuda Xiono]], who tripped over a pot of fruits and vegetables, causing the Gabdorin to angrily shoo Xiono away from his wares. Darrb's home was later trespassed by Xiono and a Resistance [[spy]], [[Norath Kev]], leading him to request the aid of [[First Order stormtrooper]]s to remove them. When the Resistance members bested the stormtroopers, Darrb took it upon himself to order them out of his home.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Yeager, I was a spy. I'm a master at keeping a low profile.|Kazuda Xiono to [[Jarek Yeager]] moments before he tripped over Darrb's merchandise|audio=MasterOfLowProfile-TheMissingAgent.flac|<ref name="The Missing Agent" />}}
Darrb was a [[Gabdorin]]<ref name="SWE" /> [[Gender|male]]<ref name="The Missing Agent" /> [[Merchant|vendor]] with a [[Darrb's stand|stand]] in<ref name="SWE" /> the [[Vargo Spaceport]]<ref name="The Missing Agent" /> on the [[planet]] [[Varkana]], his [[homeworld]].<ref name="SWE" /> In [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date Note">{{ResistanceDate|2|12}}</ref> [[Resistance]] member [[Kazuda Xiono]] and<ref name="The Missing Agent" /> his<ref name="SWE" /> [[droid]] [[CB-23]] traveled to the [[spaceport]] from the ''[[Colossus]]'' [[space station]] as CB-23 [[Rescue of Norath Kev|honed]] in on a Resistance [[distress signal]]. While there, Xiono tripped over a pot of Darrb's, spilling various [[fruit]]s and [[vegetable]]s. The vendor shouted angrily at Xiono in an [[alien]] [[language]]. Although Xiono apologized before departing, Darrb tossed one of the [[Foodstuff|produce]] at the Resistance member in frustration. As Darrb walked the spaceport, the Gabdorin drank from a container.<ref name="The Missing Agent" /> Later that [[Local day|night]], Darrb was stopped by two [[First Order stormtrooper]]s and was shown a wanted poster for Xiono and [[Norath Kev]], a [[Duros]] Resistance [[spy]].<ref name="Breakout" />

[[File:KazudaAndDarrb-Breakout.png|thumb|left|300px|Kazuda Xiono requested permission to hide in Darrb's home.]]
While trying to run from two [[First Order]] stormtroopers, Xiono and Kev encountered Darrb heading into his [[Darrb's house|home]]. They initially asked the Gabdorin if they could hide in his home. With the First Order about to apprehend them, they declared there was no [[time]] to await permission to enter the home and carried Darrb inside. He expressed concern about being [[Thief|robbed]] before Kev and Xiono covered the Gabdorin's [[mouth]] with their [[Limb|hands]]. The stormtroopers passed by the home, with Darrb unable to call for their help. He then stomped Kev's foot, causing the Duros to holler in pain and alert the stormtroopers outside.<ref name="Breakout" />

The two stormtroopers knocked on the door and demanded it be opened. When their demands went unmet, one of the stormtroopers shot the door's control panel, opening the door to reveal a terrified Darrb holding a pot of fruits and vegetables. They asked the Gabdorin if two Resistance spies had been present. Darrb attempted to discreetly signal that the spies were behind the stormtroopers, but Kev and Xiono knocked the two [[trooper]]s out. He then demanded that the two Resistance members leave afterward, throwing produce at the two as they departed and dragged the stormtroopers with them.<ref name="Breakout" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|This is absurd. Get out of my house.|Darrb, while Xiono and Kev attempted to silence him|translated=1|audio=ThisIsAbsurd-Breakout.flac|<ref name="Breakout" />}}
Darrb was protective of his wares and home, expressing anger and throwing food at Xiono when the Resistance member tripped and made a mess of his stall.<ref name="The Missing Agent" /> When the spies later trespassed into his home, he was willing to draw the attention of the First Order to maintain the sanctity of his home and, when the spies left, again showed his anger by launching food at the retreating spies. Darrb had [[Color|purple]] skin and yellow [[eye]]s.<ref name="Breakout" /> When Darrb interacted with Kev and Xiono, he spoke a non-[[Galactic Basic Standard|Basic]] language.<ref name="Bucket's List">{{SW|url=news/buckets-list-extra-breakout-star-wars-resistance|text=Bucket's List Extra: 4 Fun Facts from "Breakout" - ''Star Wars Resistance''}}</ref>

==Equipment==
When Darrb encountered Xiono, he wore a tan [[Clothing|shirt]] with two vertical green stripes on either side and a green collar. The sleeves had white wraps on the forearm and ended with a brown cuff. He wore brown pants that were tan at the knees with a blue trim, along with a brown [[belt]] and brown [[boot]]s. He used a light brown pot to carry fruits and vegetables.<ref name="The Missing Agent" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Amleto-ConceptArt.png|thumb|right|150px|Amleto, the Elomin whose role Darrb replaced]]
Darrb first appeared in "[[The Missing Agent]],"<ref name="The Missing Agent" /> the twelfth episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'' animated television series, which aired on [[December 22]], [[2019]].<ref name="Press">{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}}</ref> He was credited as "Vendor."<ref name="The Missing Agent" /> On [[December 29]] of that year,<ref name="Press" /> Darrb appeared in the next episode, "[[Breakout]],"<ref name="Breakout" /> with the subtitles identifying the Gabdorin as Darrb,<ref name="Subtitles">{{Resistance|Breakout}} {{Subtitles|Disney+}}</ref> although he was credited as "Citizen."<ref name="Breakout" /> [[Jonathan Lipow]] voiced him in both appearances.<ref name="The Missing Agent" /><ref name="Breakout" /> He was initially shown in the trailer previewing Season Two, which was posted earlier in the year on the official ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Wikipedia:YouTube|YouTube]] channel, on [[August 14]].<ref name="S2">{{SWYouTube|JkJtdJKCVto|Star Wars Resistance Season 2 - Trailer (Official)|sw_url=video/disneyxd-season-2-trailer-star-wars-resistance|date=2019-08-14}}</ref>

The Gabdorin did not speak Basic, but the script had dialogue written to convey what the alien language needed to sound like.<ref name="Bucket's List" /> [[Steven Melching]], the writer for "Breakout," originally included<ref name="Melching">{{WookYouTube|_aRy5PWaiPY|Wookieepedia Interviews - Steven Melching (Part 1)|date=2025-06-18}}</ref> Resistance [[pilot]]<ref name="SWE" /> [[Poe Dameron]] as part of the Resistance group on Varkana. As such, Darrb would have interacted with Dameron during the episode's events.<ref name="Melching" /> Darrb's role in "Breakout" was originally scripted to be for another Resistance spy, the [[Elomin]] [[Amleto]]. Amleto was fully designed before being cut from the arc, and her key moment was instead given to Darrb.<ref name="Bucket's List" />
